title: Core 11 at 2 km: observation-forced OCX run of the submission line seq1f, with the resistive-stress calving law
mesh: antarctica_5000_2000_buffered0 (Rice's build, 925,183 vertices, 1,835,718 cells, 2 km fine, 5 km interior, no buffer), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling, ocean-drag gate on the 1,642 open-water cells beyond the t=0 extent
initial_state: seq1's relaxed re-inverted MAP, /scratch/ah301/ismip7-routine-out/seq1/map_r_friction2.h5 (md5 2dad56d40a1fdd654f909301335946ca, 14 Oct 2026): sequential Budd inversion on the sub-element friction (shelf fluidity then friction, 60/60/30/30 iterations) warm-started from the 13 Oct release MAP map_hf5k_w14k_rho75k_snap20261013b.h5, Pattyn fluidity prior, sqrt friction control, bilaplacian prior with rho 7.5 km for the fluidity and 75 km for the friction, sigma-normalised misfit scaled by 14000, dH/dt term weight 1 under a 5 km Helmholtz filter; then a 20-year relaxation 2015 to 2035 on the control climatology and the same re-inversion on the relaxed geometry with the fluidity control on floating ice only
branch_from: cold start from the MAP, geometry backdated 12 years with the Smith dH/dt
forcing: the protocol OCX product (ISMIP7_OCX_FORCING=protocol): observed SMB with dacabfdz and the varying observed ocean tf and so, 2003 to 2025
melt: Burgard quadratic with K 6.5e-5 and the per-basin deltaT of deltaT_per_basin_2000_K6.500e-05.npz, the constant mean-Antarctic slope
front: resistive-stress law (hfb, sigma_max 0.15 MPa) through icepack_tools, retreat only (ISMIP7_FRONT_ADVANCE=none) against the t=0 extent anchor, land fronts never calve, exact front push; no ice-shelf collapse (ISMIP7_FRACTURE=none)
dt: 0.05 with adaptive transport substeps (1 m thickness-error tolerance, 4 to 64 substeps, the diagnostic re-solved per substep)
site: Rice NOTS, scavenge partition on cascadelake or sapphirerapids nodes in 1-hour chain links with auto-resume (12-hour commons links on 27 and 28 Oct), under the strict routine watch
resources: 32 ranks, 128G (240G until 23 Oct), scpc_mumps; host-side MUMPS analysis from 28 Oct
code: NOTS checkout /scratch/ah301/ismip7-routine on the fix/routine-restart-budget line at af29fe07 (the 20 to 24 Oct restart, watch and retry fixes cherry-picked while the suite ran; merged as icepack/ismip7 pull requests 176 and 177), icepack_tools on fix/front-face-rate
cost: 7 chain links, 5.7 h of wall time at 32 ranks (182 core-hours), about 15 min per model year
audit: resid 0.0000 Gt on all 460 rows; VAF +13.6 mm SLE and mass +352 Gt over 23 years against the observed loss (the discharge deficit of the relaxed MAP)
